description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (qwen4_exp) on the pulsar engine, single GB10 (L251). Routed experts AND dense Linears run on the EXL3 trellis GEMV (K=2..5, exllamav3 bit-compatible, L245) wherever both dims are multiples of 128; MXFP8_E4M3 (mxfp8_lt, E4M3 + E8M0/32) is the 8-bit tier; the token embedding and output head are plain bf16 (fidelity choice). The MoE router, the gated-residual low-rank read (hc_lowrank 320 is not a multiple of 128) and the DeltaNet a/b projections (48 rows) have no EXL3 form and take MXFP8 or BF16. 1-D params, conv kernels, the shared-expert sigmoid gate and the 4-row block_inject stay BF16. The PLE n-gram table is not allocated here: it ships on the disk path (Qwen's own FP8 bytes).

export_lane.exporter: pulsar tools/container direct builder (out of tree; per-tensor format map)
export_lane.detail: pulsar's builder writes exactly the formats its engine has kernels for; the declaration module mirrors its format-map vocabulary

format_rules.detail: token embedding and output head ship as plain bf16 (source-exact)
router (a route flip is not a smooth cost; held at 8 bits or source), gated-residual low-rank (320 wide) and DeltaNet a/b (48 rows): no EXL3 tiling
routed experts, shared expert, DeltaNet qkv/z/out, QSA q/k/v/o + indexer, PLE key/value: the EXL3 trellis GEMV or the 8-bit tier

shape_rules.detail: EXL3 applies a 128-blockwise Hadamard along the input dim (and the output dim: pulsar_qwen_formats refuses out % 128 != 0)
OCP MX formats scale 32-element groups along the input dim
